def fn(t0, t1, t2, ta, k, lst, dct):
    idx1 = torch.tensor([2, 0], device=t2.device)
    t2.index_fill_(0, idx1, -2)
    v2 = torch.roll(ta, 2, 1)
    v3 = t1.unfold(0, 3, 4)
    v4 = t1.diagonal()
    v5 = torch.roll(t2, 1, 0)
    v3.fill_(-5)
    ta.abs_()
    v2[7] = k
    return (t0, v3, t0, lst, dct)
